# LainDain (Land10) — B2B Wholesale Marketplace

> Pakistan's premier B2B wholesale marketplace connecting verified manufacturers and suppliers with wholesale buyers, retailers, and distributors.

## Overview
LainDain provides a seamless digital trading experience for B2B transactions, featuring verified supplier listings, product catalog navigation, MOQ quantity setup, real-time search, and a streamlined wholesale checkout pipeline.

## Main Services & Features
- **Supplier Catalog**: Filtered supplier inventory across Textile & Apparel, Leather Goods, Surgical Instruments, Sporting Goods, Electronics, and Food & Agriculture.
- **Wholesale Order Stepper**: Flexible Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) ordering with bulk tier pricing.
- **Supplier Verification**: AI-assisted supplier identity and verification scoring.
- **Real-Time Search & Category Filters**: Multi-faceted product and supplier search.
- **Secure Authentication**: JWT-based session control for buyers and sellers.

## Technical Details
- Frontend: React (Vite, TailwindCSS)
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth)
- Deployment: Vercel (Frontend), Render (Backend API)
